_about: Gas-phase jobs of the BTPC revision for piserver (plan section 5 items 5-6), split out of jobs_main.json on 21 Nov 2026 (review finding 3) so that msi and piserver run at the same time with all cores.
Only gas-phase work: piserver is about 3.35x slower than msi per gas step (measured 20 Nov: SCF cycle 3.46x, gradient 3.16x) and no PCM optimisation or Hessian is placed there.
Nothing here depends on msi jobs and nothing on msi depends on these; copy {root}/out/ back to the Pi as each job finishes (piserver has no backup).
Run from the repository copy on piserver (needs dft/, molecules/, data/r2/molecules/btpc/results/btpc_gas/hessian.npy for the seed and the soft-mode reference):

cd <run-dir>/repo; MAX_MEMORY_MB=12000 setsid nohup <run-dir>/env/bin/python dft/revision/jobqueue.py run --jobs dft/revision/jobs_piserver.json --root <run-dir>/queue_pi --slots 1 --threads 4 > <run-dir>/queue_pi.out 2>&1 &
Power is marginal until the 27 W supply arrives: check vcgencmd get_throttled after each job (project notes, not deposited).

est_hours = piserver wall hours (msi estimate x 3.35); est_hours_msi for reference. Total mid 139 h (low 90, high 222) against about 203 h to the Sun 29 Nov freeze; scan_tors_d3 is last and is the first cut (plan section 5: 'the D3(BJ) half of item 6').

jobs.item: 5 (B3LYP-D3(BJ) gas re-optimisation, seeded with the stored gas Hessian, FMO at the minimum)
jobs.cost: 20-60 gas evaluations x 7.3 min (msi) + final analysis

jobs.item: 5 (soft-mode check at the D3(BJ) gas minimum; 21 gas gradients)
jobs.cost: x0 SCF + 20 gas gradients x 7.3 min (msi)

jobs.item: 6 (relaxed gas scan of C1-O1...N4-C12, -180 to -60 deg in 15 deg steps, B3LYP)
jobs.cost: 9 points x 10-25 gas evaluations x 7.3 min (msi)

jobs.item: 6 (the same scan with B3LYP-D3(BJ), from the D3(BJ) gas minimum; cut first if time is short)
jobs.priority: last; cut first if time is short
jobs.cost: 9 points x 10-25 gas evaluations x 7.3 min (msi)
